verdict.rationale: Motion documents a public REST API with an endpoint reference, and a probe confirms the API is live. However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent). The human-readable API reference and the marketing-oriented llms.txt are adjacent features, and the engineering comment about internal Zod models for OpenAPI does not show a published, downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
